_comment: Interior strike demo (#1834). A 144-man Infantry block (12 files by 12 ranks) stands with a 6-man enemy Infantry squad spawned at its centre, five or six ranks in from every edge. Only a block's near-front ranks strike (three ranks for a 1.3 m gladius at a 0.45 m rank pitch), and 'front' follows the slot grid, so before this fix the men around the squad never struck it: the squad fought inside the block and was struck only when a re-face happened to bring a striking rank within reach (on main a3714751 the squad is still on the field at tick 600 with 4 men, and the block has lost its first man by tick 470). With the fix every man of the block within reach of an enemy inside it, behind the striking ranks, strikes him: the squad is cut down by about tick 220 and the block loses nobody. drill:true keeps the battle running after the squad is gone, so the clip shows the block standing afterwards. Deterministic: seed + a custom scenario, no input steps. Verified by a 10-tick state dump on head and on main; both expects below fail on main (the squad is present through tick 600, and the block has 143 men at tick 600).

shape_residual.reason: After the squad dies (about tick 220) the block is judged out of contact while it recovers from its slot grid winding round under the men during the fight: with the enemy at its centre, each small combat re-face snaps the heading toward a moving bearing and turns the whole grid (#1792), 115 degrees of facing travel between ticks 2 and 220. Dense 2-tick worst 38.9 against 13.5 over ticks 220 to 600; the 10-tick declared samples here read 38.9. On the #1792 candidate (62c5fc40 applied on this head) the same clip holds its facing and reads 2.55. Main never leaves contact in this clip, so it is never judged. Remove once #1792 lands.
